name: EOD 2026-06-23
body:
> Eod · 2026-06-23

Tuesday. Multi-client report covering 6 sessions from the evening of 6/22 into 6/23: Alphalete local page build-out, Summit AZ audit and 4 new posts, Pipeliners audit.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Local pages: published 21 drain cleaning pages (IDs 12401 to 12421), 43 commercial trenchless pipelining pages (IDs 12455 to 12497) and 13 hydro jetting pages (IDs 12541 to 12553). All three services now at 44 of 44 cities. Manitou Springs drain draft (12389) still pending review.
- Bug flagged: "Areas We Also Serve" widget on the commercial and new hydro pages links to root-level URLs that 404 (real URLs are under /services/).
- ZIP audit of 220 service-area pages: 93 pages carry the wrong 80908/80921/80132 triple. Fixed the 3 Lone Tree pages via Elementor's API.
- Code Snippet 11 (noindex non-keeper towns): renamed allowlist to "indexable", added Lone Tree to the 8 metros, plus a full-slug force-index list for 18 commercial pages. A PHP escaping bug briefly deactivated it before the clean version went live. Backup saved.
- GSC: 5 Lone Tree pages and 6 of 18 commercial pages submitted before quota hit.
- Fixed 4 real GSC 404s (old city-hub slugs) with new `.htaccess` 301 rules.
- Inventory: 220 of 220 pages published, 45 index and 175 noindex (35 towns). Indexing Tracker v2 and ZIP audit sheets in Drive.
- Content: June pillar "Backed Up Sewer Line Symptoms" (70 volume, KD 0) plus 2 supporting drafts written; 2 blog rewrites and 5 service page rewrites paste-ready; Littleton and Lone Tree drafts in Drive. None posted yet.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Audit: the 5 posts from 6/19 confirmed live, indexed and AZ-localized. Four items for decision: two alias pages that canonicalize elsewhere (recommend 301), 4 footer links missing trailing slashes, water-heater alt text, a 64-character title.
- Published 4 posts via WP-CLI: Are Water Softeners Worth It (5821), Tankless vs Tank Water Heater (5824), Signs of a Slab Leak (5827), Trenchless Pipe Lining (5830). About 1,150 words each, FAQ, tables, verified citations, no em dashes or competitors.
- Checked 120 service-area URLs: all live and already indexed. Clean canonical list delivered (91 source URLs lacked trailing slashes).

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Biggest blocker: OTTO injects 36 homepage links to /service-areas/{city}/ URLs that 301 to the flat /{city}/ canonicals. An earlier same-day audit file had the direction backwards and should not be used.
- 164 actionable not-indexed URLs; GSC quota already exhausted, and inspection showed "No referring sitemap", confirming a sitemap root cause.

# Internal
- Summit SSH alias re-verified; 3 client keypairs present. See [SSH Client Aliases](lib:brain-ssh-client-aliases).

# Follow-ups
- Alphalete: submit remaining 12 commercial pages; validate and publish the blog drafts; paste service and blog rewrites; paste Littleton and add it to Snippet 11; batch-fix the 90 remaining ZIP pages; review Manitou draft; fix the "Areas We Also Serve" links; plan content for Tier 2 towns.
- Summit AZ: decide on the alias page redirects; request indexing for the 4 new posts.
- Pipeliners: fix or disable the OTTO module so homepage links point to flat canonicals; retry the 164-URL list.
